english.title: Receive scrap metal and fail to keep a copy of document verifying name / address - site manager
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) you were the site manager of **(..SPECIFY SITE..) at which **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a scrap metal dealer, upon receiving scrap metal from a person, failed to keep a copy of a document used to verify that person's name or address, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE DOCUMENT THAT WAS NOT COPIED AND KEPT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 13(3) and 15(4) and 15(6) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.

english.notes: It is a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that they made arrangements to ensure that the requirement was fulfilled and took all reasonable steps to ensure that those arrangements were complied with.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
